description: This file defines internal common utilities and classes for the Abseil container library, including node handle implementations for sets and maps, type traits, and related concepts.

classes.name: node_handle_base
classes.description: Base class for node handles, managing resource transfer and destruction for set and map node handles.

classes.name: node_handle (set specialization)
classes.description: Node handle for set elements, providing access to the value.

classes.name: node_handle (map specialization)
classes.description: Node handle for map elements, providing access to key and mapped value.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys the node handle's resource if not empty.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the node handle to empty state.

methods.name: construct
methods.description: Constructs a node handle with given arguments.
